page.layout: Printed page 366 with two columns of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries, left column then right column. Running heads at top left and top right. Catchword at the lower right of the right column.

main_text.l: pl. f.& pl.m. præf. (pro כְּצְבָיִם, בִּצְבָיוֹת) à f. m. צְבִי ; Rad. צָבָה intu-muit.
צְבָאִי militia mea, צְבָאָה ejus, צְבָאָם ipsorum, צְבָאוֹת exercitus, צְבָאֵינוּ nostri, צְבָאַי mei, No. f. m. צָבָא, aff. & pl. f. aff. R. צָבָא militare.
מִ־צָּבָה propter exercitum, Zach.9.8.(pro מִצָּבָא,) No. f. m. צָבָא, præf. Rad. צָבָא.
לְ־צָבוֹת ad tumidum reddendum, Num. 5. 22. pro לְהַצְבּוֹת , Infin. Hiph. præf. Rad. צָבָה.
צְבִי decus, צְבִיָּה caprea, צְבָיִם capreæ, No. f. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad. צָבָה intumuit.
cam, Jef. 29. 7. (pro צִבְאָיָה,) Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. Rad. צָבָא.
צָבְתָה intumuit illa, pret. Kal, 3. f. f. R. צָבָה.
הַצְּבָאִים manipuli, pl. m. præf. No. Rad. f. m. צָבָה manipulus.
הַצָּד venans, Ben. Kal, Rad. צוּד.
צַד latus, צִדָּה ejus, 1. Sam.20.20.(pro צִדָּה,) מִצִּדּוֹ ex latere ejus, לְצִדִּים ad latera, בְּ־צִדֵיכֶם in lateribus vestris, No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. צַד.
צֵדָה viaticum, No. sing. fæm. Rad. צוּד venatus est.
צָרָה venaris, Ben. Kal, f. m. Rad. צָדָה.
צָדּוּ venantur, pret. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. צָדָה, vel צוּד.

page.notes: Hebrew forms in the left column are small and partly blurred; the vowel points in entries such as מִ־צָּבָה, לְ־צָבוֹת and הַצְּבָאִים are read from the scan and not fully certain. The word after "pro" in the entry "pl. f.& pl.m. præf." is doubtful, as is "à" after "f. m." in the same entry. Entry "צֹבָאִים militantes contra" is the last line of the left column and continues on the next page. The right-hand entry "צַד latus" contains a doubtful Hebrew form before "ad latera" (לְצִדִּים). Hebrew in the right column is clearer. The entry "צָדּוּ venantur" is read as printed.
